_read_me: Normalised rows of the POST /vulns/export of 2026-09-03, reduced to the nine fields that summarise() and detect_batches() read, in COLUMNAR form (one list of values per row, in the order of `fields`) so as not to repeat the keys 4,278 times. `asset_name` became a stable label: the real name only matters for grouping windows. Every number of the M4 golden test comes from here.
